8
# Guards no production path reaches.
#
# Every `pub fn` named check/verify/validate/require/enforce/assert/reject/
# refuse/deny/guard is a refusal by its own naming. Eight of them are
# reachable only from tests, which means they protect the tests.
#
# The number may only go down. Wiring one up, or moving it into a module that
# honestly declares `WIRING: unwired`, lowers it; lower this file in the same
# pull request or the gain is given back silently.
#
# Not a hard zero on purpose. Some of what remains should not be wired at all:
# `verify_answer_challenge_zk_proof` returns `Err` unconditionally on purpose,
# because a Merkle proof not bound to its deal and challenge context is
# replayable across storage deals and networks, and callers are meant to use
# `answer_challenge`, which rebuilds that context from registry state. Calling
# it would satisfy this gate and weaken the chain. A number that can only fall
# gets paid down; a number driven to zero by wiring refusals that exist to
# stay unwired is worse than the number it replaced.
#
# The eight, at the time this baseline was set:
#
#   src/ai/execution/verify.rs              verify_execution_proof_structural
#   src/ai/execution/verify.rs              verify_execution_proof_full
#   src/budlumxyz/mod.rs                    verify_app
#   src/core/block.rs                       verify_signature_with_pubkey
#   src/cross_domain/evm/adapter.rs         verify_deposit
#   src/domain/storage_deal.rs              verify_answer_challenge_zk_proof
#   src/lubot/mod.rs                        validate_inference_grant
#   src/lubot/verify.rs                     verify_inference_stark
